ud5.9:1.2: at one time the Fortunate One was walking on walking tour amongst the Kosalans, together with a great Community of monks.
ud5.9:1.3: Then at that time a great many young brāhmaṇas were passing by not far from the Fortunate One in a mocking manner.
ud5.9:1.4: The Fortunate One saw those many young brāhmaṇas passing by not far away in a mocking manner.
ud5.9:2.1: Then the Fortunate One, having understood the significance of it, on that occasion uttered this exalted utterance:
ud5.9:3.1: “The deluded with an appearance of wisdom, have speech as their only domain,
ud5.9:3.3: Stretching their mouths as much as they want, ~ they are led on by what they don’t understand.”
